newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN yr 2000 provisions 340 mln dfl so far.
newsitem.headline: ABN yr 2000 provisions 340 mln dfl so far.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Thursday it had made provisions associated with the single European currency and the year 2000 of 340 million guilders in calendar 1996.
The bank said these provisions were for the adaptation of software for the introduction of the euro and the change in computer programmes associated with the year 2000.
ABN AMRO repeated its earlier forecast that total costs associated with these two projects would be more than 500 million guilders.
"At year-end 1996 this provision amounted to 340 million guilders, of which 215 million is in the Netherlands and 125 million abroad," the bank said.
